Generated from the clap definition of the `canon` command line in [`crates/canon-cli/src/lib.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/crates/canon-cli/src/lib.rs). It lists only commands that exist; commands the design proposes are on the [status page](../status/where-this-stands.md).

`canon`: Evidence-governed protocol toolchain. `canon --version` prints its version, and `--help` after any command prints the text shown below.

|---|---|

| [`canon conform run`](#canon-conform-run) | Run every `canon-conformance/1` scenario of a registry directory and report each |

## `canon evaluate`

Evaluate every claim of a compiled protocol for a case from an evidence set, and print the `canon-decision/1` document

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ir <IR>` | yes | none | The compiled protocol: `canon-ir/1` exactly as `canon compile` prints it |
| `--case <CASE>` | yes | none | The `canon-case/1` case snapshot |
| `--evidence <EVIDENCE>` | yes | none | A directory holding only `canon-evidence/1` records, one per `*.yaml` or `*.json` file |
| `--authority <AUTHORITY>` | no | none | A `canon-authority/1` document of authority decisions. Read and passed through; not supported yet |
| `--at <AT>` | no | none | The evaluation instant, in UTC as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. Evidence older than its kind's `max_age` at this instant does not apply; without it, no evidence expires |

```text
Evaluate every claim of a compiled protocol for a case from an evidence set, and print the `canon-decision/1` document

Usage: canon evaluate [OPTIONS] --ir <IR> --case <CASE> --evidence <EVIDENCE>

Options:
      --ir <IR>
          The compiled protocol: `canon-ir/1` exactly as `canon compile` prints it

      --case <CASE>
          The `canon-case/1` case snapshot

      --evidence <EVIDENCE>
          A directory holding only `canon-evidence/1` records, one per `*.yaml` or `*.json` file

      --authority <AUTHORITY>
          A `canon-authority/1` document of authority decisions. Read and passed through; not supported yet

      --at <AT>
          The evaluation instant, in UTC as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. Evidence older than its kind's `max_age` at this instant does not apply; without it, no evidence expires

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `canon conform run`

Run every `canon-conformance/1` scenario of a registry directory and report each

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--scenarios <SCENARIOS>` | no | `conformance/scenarios` | The registry directory; every `*.yaml` file in it is one scenario |

```text
Run every `canon-conformance/1` scenario of a registry directory and report each

Usage: canon conform run [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --scenarios <SCENARIOS>
          The registry directory; every `*.yaml` file in it is one scenario

          [default: conformance/scenarios]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## Exit status

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | Success: the document is valid or compiled, the case was evaluated, or every conformance scenario ran and passed. |
| `1` | Rejected: a document was read and rejected, an evaluation was refused, a conformance scenario failed or was unreadable, or no scenario ran. |
| `2` | Unreadable: an input file or directory could not be read. |
